name: japan-intel-mcp
display_name: Japan Intel MCP — 日本の公開情報
description: Read-only Japan public intelligence for AI agents: earthquakes, weather warnings, weekly forecasts with temperatures, typhoons, EDINET corporate filings, and postal lookup. All sources free and keyless.
long_description: Japan Intel MCP exposes Japan's live public information to AI agents through eight read-only tools: japan_earthquakes, japan_weather_warnings, japan_weather_overview, japan_weekly_forecast (temperatures and precipitation probabilities), japan_typhoons, japan_edinet_filings (corporate regulatory disclosures), japan_postal_lookup, and japan_watch_summary. All sources are free and keyless: the Japan Meteorological Agency and EDINET. Every response returns an envelope with retrieved_at, sources, and data_gaps, so agents never silently lose a data source.
